label: Jaipur, Rajasthan
tagline: The Pink City - forts, palaces and bazaars.

hotels.name: Zostel Jaipur
hotels.note: Rooftop hostel with dorms and private rooms, walkable to the railway station.

hotels.name: Hotel Pearl Palace
hotels.note: Long-running budget favourite with a famously good rooftop restaurant.

hotels.name: Umaid Bhawan Heritage House
hotels.note: Heritage-style rooms, courtyard pool and puppet shows in the evening.

hotels.name: Alsisar Haveli
hotels.note: Restored 19th-century haveli with frescoed rooms around a pool courtyard.

hotels.name: Samode Haveli
hotels.note: 225-year-old nobleman's mansion inside the walled city, painted dining hall.

hotels.name: Rambagh Palace
hotels.note: The former royal residence; peacocks on the lawns and a genuinely palatial stay.

hotels.name: Hotel Arya Niwas
hotels.note: Quiet, clean and central with a leafy garden cafe; reliable mid-budget pick.

things_to_do.name: Amber Fort (Amer Palace)
things_to_do.note: Hilltop fort of mirrored halls and ramparts; go at opening to beat the crowd.

things_to_do.name: Hawa Mahal
things_to_do.note: The honeycomb facade of 953 windows; best photographed from the cafe opposite.

things_to_do.name: City Palace
things_to_do.note: Still partly the royal family's home; the Peacock Gate courtyard is the highlight.

things_to_do.name: Jantar Mantar
things_to_do.note: UNESCO-listed 18th-century observatory with the world's largest stone sundial.

things_to_do.name: Nahargarh Fort sunset
things_to_do.note: The classic sunset view over the whole city; short climb from the car park.

things_to_do.name: Johari Bazaar walk
things_to_do.note: Jewellery, block prints and lac bangles; go in the evening when it comes alive.

eateries.name: Rawat Mishthan Bhandar
eateries.note: The kachori institution - expect a queue, it moves fast.

eateries.name: Spice Court
eateries.must_try: Laal maas and dal baati churma
eateries.note: Reliable sit-down Rajasthani food with a pleasant outdoor courtyard.

eateries.name: Chokhi Dhani
eateries.note: Village-themed dinner park with folk dance, camel rides and crafts.
